_note: The benchmark this study measures on, pinned by digest. Hashed into ProtocolBinding as
bench_manifest_sha, which was the empty string until this file existed -- so the qrels
vintage, the query count and the split contents were pinned only by Python constants
(qrels.py BCPLUS_QUERY_COUNT = 830) and by a manifest sitting beside the data. A
constant in the code and a file on a run host are not the same kind of fact as a digest
inside the approval: the first two can change without invalidating anything.
Corpus and index shard digests are deliberately NOT repeated here. They are already inside
protocol/retrieval_freeze.json, which is separately bound, and a second copy is a second
browsecomp_plus_decrypted.jsonl is the answer key. Its digest is recorded; its contents are
evaluator-only and never enter this repository.

splits.method: pure random; the decrypted records carry no topic or answer-type field to stratify on

retriever._note: identity lives in protocol/retrieval_freeze.json; named here so a reader knows where to look
